channel.title: Claude Code Live Cheatsheet
channel.description: Auto-updating cheatsheet for Claude Code — keyboard shortcuts, commands, tips, and more.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.210 highlights
item.description:
• Permission rules: Write/Glob/NotebookEdit paths → use Edit/Read instead (v2.1.210)
  • Screen reader mode announces permission mode changes with Shift+Tab (v2.1.210)
  • MEMORY.md over read limit now produces explicit error (v2.1.210)
  • Agents footer shows count of background agents waiting for input (v2.1.210)
  • Bash timeout message distinguishes hang from explicit background (v2.1.210)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.210
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

~ [config-env] deny: tool-name glob: * denies all; Tool(param:value) matches; Write/Glob/NotebookEdit→Edit/Read
~ [config-env] axScreenReader: Opt-in plain-text rendering; announces permission mode changes
~ [config-env] CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER: Set 1 to enable screen reader mode; announces permission mode changes
~ [memory-files] MEMORY.md: Memory index + topic files; errors if over read limit

Full changelog

• Added a live elapsed-time counter to the collapsed tool summary line so long-running tool calls visibly tick instead of looking stuck
• Added a startup warning for `Write(path)`, `NotebookEdit(path)`, and `Glob(path)` permission rules — use `Edit(path)` or `Read(path)` instead
• Fixed `isolation: 'worktree'` subagents being able to run git-mutating commands against the main repo checkout instead of their own isolated worktree
• Fixed the `ultracode` keyword opt-in firing on non-human-originated input such as webhook payloads and relayed PR comments
• Fixed a rendered text fragment leaking into crash telemetry when a UI component returned content outside a styled text element
• Fixed paste markers leaking into external editors opened from Claude Code, which could appear as stray È/É characters around pasted text
• Fixed `claude attach` sometimes failing with "job not found" or "agent is still starting" errors during session transitions — attach now waits for the daemon to settle, and terminal resizes during a slow attach are applied once it completes
• Fixed a session crash when a tool's result renderer returned a numeric bigint value or plain text instead of a UI element
• Fixed a hook callback timeout being misreported to the model as a user rejection, which made unattended sessions stop and wait
• Fixed Claude assuming a `cd` took effect after its command was moved to the background; the tool result now states the working directory is unchanged
• Fixed plugin-provided MCP servers being torn down when MCP servers are re-synced mid-session
• Fixed plan approvals without edits being labeled "(edited by user)" and overwriting the plan file with a stale snapshot
• Fixed `/doctor` skipping its auto-mode-default proposal on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, where auto mode no longer needs an opt-in
• Fixed Grep content mode claiming "No matches found" when paginating past the end of results
• Fixed unmatched `$1`/`$2` positional placeholders in skills and commands being silently stripped; they are now preserved verbatim
• Fixed plugin cache writes leaving temp files behind on failure and failing on locked-file renames on Windows and network filesystems
• Fixed background workers crash-looping when a client resets its connection to the background service
• Fixed `claude agents --effort ultracode` not reaching dispatched sessions; the value was silently dropped
• Fixed pressing ← to open the agents view dropping the task tracker when returning to the session
• Fixed the agents dashboard retaining pasted images from abandoned reply drafts after their session was deleted
• Fixed killed background sessions leaving a permanent `git worktree lock` behind; the periodic sweep now releases locks whose owning process is gone
• Fixed SDK MCP servers registered via an `initialize` control request waiting until the next turn to start connecting
• Fixed returning to the agents view from a session leaving overlapping ghost frames with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ALTERNATE_SCREEN=1`
• Fixed late-appearing `.claude/*` symlinks not being reconciled into the sandbox deny-write list
• Hardened the Agent tool against indirect prompt injection via content a subagent read
• Improved the Bash/PowerShell tool message when a command hits its timeout and is auto-backgrounded, so the model can distinguish a hang from an explicit background request
• Improved auto mode: the permission classifier now defaults to Sonnet 5 for external sessions, validated on the session's first request and pinned for the session
• Improved the bundled dataviz skill's chart color validation with perceptual OKLab color difference and recalibrated color-blindness thresholds
• Memory writes that leave a MEMORY.md index over its read limit now produce an explicit error instead of silent truncation
• Screen reader mode now announces permission mode changes aloud when cycling modes with Shift+Tab
• The agents footer hint now shows how many background agents are waiting on your input, with a brief color emphasis when the count changes
• Agent view: the session you pressed ← from stays visibly marked even after mouse hover or arrow keys move the selection
• Fable temporarily shows as unavailable in the advisor picker while a server-side issue causing Fable advisor failures is fixed

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.208
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [cli-flags] --ax-screen-reader: Opt-in plain-text rendering for screen reader users
+ [config-env] axScreenReader: Opt-in plain-text rendering for screen readers
+ [config-env] vimInsertModeRemaps: Map insert-mode sequences like jj to Escape in vim mode
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER: Set 1 to enable screen reader mode
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER: Corporate launcher wrapper; agent view/bg service self-spawn through it
~ [cli-flags] --dangerously-skip-permissions: Skip all prompts; catastrophic rm (incl. $()/backticks) still prompts ⚠️
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] Ctrl+X Ctrl+K: Kill bg agents; agents view: remove session + worktree, preserve unpushed commits
- [cli-flags] --console
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE
- [config-env] workflowKeywordTrigger

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.207
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] disableAutoMode: Disable auto mode in settings.json
~ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE: No longer needed for auto mode opt-in on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry (now default)
~ [workflows-tips] Auto mode: Built-in for Max and Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry; disableAutoMode to disable
- [config-env] requiredMinimumVersion / requiredMaximumVersion

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.206
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

~ [slash-commands] /cd [path]: Move session to new working directory with path suggestions; no prompt cache break
~ [slash-commands] /doctor: Setup checkup: diagnose/fix issues; suggest CLAUDE.md trim (/checkup alias)
~ [workflows-tips] EnterWorktree (switch): Switch between Claude-managed worktrees; confirms if outside project dir
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] Ctrl+X Ctrl+K: Kill background agents; agents view: permanently remove completed session

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.205
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

~ [slash-commands] /doctor: Full setup checkup: diagnose and fix issues (/checkup alias)
~ [mcp-servers] workspace: Reserved names — skipped: workspace, Claude Browser, Claude Preview

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.203
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [mcp-servers] roots/list: Additional working dirs advertised; notifications/roots/list_changed on changes
+ [slash-commands] /status: Show session status and diagnostic warnings
+ [workflows-tips] ⏸ footer badge: Shows active manual permission mode
- [slash-commands] /export

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.202
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] dynamicWorkflowSize: Set dynamic workflow size: small/medium/large agent counts (advisory)
+ [slash-commands] /review <pr>: Fast single-pass PR review
~ [skills-agents] /code-review [effort]: Multi-agent code review with effort; --comment for inline PR comments, --fix to apply findings
- [config-env] autoMode.classifyAllShell

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.200
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

~ [cli-flags] --permission-mode: plan/manual/…
~ [workflows-tips] Shift Tab: Manual → Auto-Accept → Plan

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.199
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [skills-agents] Stacked invocation: Chain up to 5 skills: /skill-a /skill-b do XYZ
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG: 300 retries for transient errors; lifts MAX_RETRIES cap of 15
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES: Max API retries; cap of 15 lifted when RETRY_WATCHDOG is set
- [skills-agents] root SKILL.md
- [config-env] sandbox.allowAppleEvents
- [config-env] OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.198
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [skills-agents] /dataviz: Chart and dashboard design guidance; runnable color-palette validator
~ [config-env] Notification: When Claude sends notification; agent_needs_input / agent_completed from bg agents
~ [skills-agents] Explore: Fast read-only (inherits session model, capped at opus)
~ [workflows-tips] isolation: worktree: Agent in own worktree; auto-commits, pushes, opens draft PR
- [slash-commands] /agents
- [skills-agents] slash commands (Skill)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.196
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG: Set 0 to disable; 5-min idle abort+retry on by default for all providers
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] ←: Open agents view
~ [slash-commands] /model [model]: Switch model; Org/Role default when admin sets one (←→ effort, s = session only)
~ [workflows-tips] API key → no cloud: API key / non-Anthropic ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL disables RC, /schedule, MCP, notifications
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.195
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS: Disable mouse click/drag/hover in fullscreen mode; wheel scroll still works
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.193
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] autoMode.classifyAllShell: Route all Bash/PowerShell commands through auto-mode classifier
+ [config-env] OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES: 1=log assistant responses in OTEL; 0=keep prompts-only; unset follows OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP: Set to 1 to disable automatic memory-pressure reaping of idle bg shells
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] !: Direct bash; file path autocomplete; Claude responds to output
- [config-env] teammateMode: "iterm2"
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_TOOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.191
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

~ [slash-commands] /rewind: Rewind conv / code checkpoint; resume from before /clear (/undo alias)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.187
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] sandbox.credentials: Block sandboxed commands from reading credential files and secret env vars
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_TOOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT: Override 5-min idle timeout for remote MCP tool calls
~ [config-env] ANTHROPIC_MODEL: Default model; org restrictions can override
~ [slash-commands] /btw <question>: Side question (no context); ←/→ step through earlier answers
- [config-env] awsAuthRefresh
- [config-env] attribution.sessionUrl

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.186
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [mcp-servers] claude mcp login <name>: Authenticate MCP server from CLI; --no-browser for SSH
+ [mcp-servers] claude mcp logout <name>: Revoke MCP server authentication from CLI
+ [config-env] teammateMode: "iterm2": Use iTerm2 backend for agent teams; warns if it2 CLI missing
+ [config-env] respondToBashCommands: false keeps ! bash output as context only (default: Claude responds)
+ [config-env] awsAuthRefresh: Adds AWS credential refresh option to /login (managed)
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES: Max API retries (caps at 15); use RETRY_WATCHDOG for unattended
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG: Alternative retry cap for unattended/headless sessions
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] !: Direct bash; Claude responds to output (respondToBashCommands: false disables)
~ [slash-commands] /workflows: View dynamic workflow runs; press f to filter status
- [config-env] language
- [config-env] enforceAvailableModels
- [config-env] allowManagedHooksOnly
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.183
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] attribution.sessionUrl: Omit claude.ai session link from commits and PRs in web/RC sessions
